D.t: John Croisant leads by 6.6 in the forecast and wins 81% of simulations. The cushion is about 16,913 votes; a one point swing is about 1,289 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +3.1 and D +16.6. A normal polling error decides it.
